activation.introTitle: How would you like to begin?
activation.introBody: You have set up your child's schedule — a good start. Many families find the biggest challenge is not getting going, but keeping the routine in the first few days when everyday life takes over. Choose what suits you:
activation.guidedTitle: Keep the routine going for the first week
activation.guidedBody: Many families appreciate a little support after the schedule is ready. Not because anything is wrong, but because new habits take time to settle.
guidedBenefits: Short daily reminders to help you keep going
See when your child completes tasks without extra nagging
Your child's schedule is already set — we help the routine work
activation.guidedCta: Yes, help us for the first week
activation.directBody: You feel ready to go on your own. Everything is in place and you can start right away.
directBenefits: Use the app at your own pace
activation.directCta: We will manage on our own
activation.footnote: Whichever you choose, you can use the app fully. Guided start simply gives a little extra support during the first week.
